skill.displayName: PowPow CLI — PowPow 技能共享执行层：登录/发帖/建数字人/删帖（写操作默认预览，--confirm 才执行）

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed PowPow command-line helper whose login, posting, deletion, upload, and verification behavior matches its stated purpose and includes confirmation gates for writes.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses network access to the pinned PowPow platform and optionally Unsplash for image search, plus local file reads/writes for drafts, previews, manifests, images, and session state; this is proportionate to the stated CLI workflow.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No package installer, dependency install script, or executable install hook was found; the artifact consists of Node.js scripts and documentation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions disclose the commands, side effects, local session storage, public posting/deletion impact, and require dry-run previews plus --confirm before write operations.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It stores a reusable JWT session in a user state directory with POSIX owner-only permissions and provides logout cleanup; this is sensitive but disclosed, scoped, and expected for an authenticated platform CLI.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill clearly presents itself as a PowPow CLI execution layer for login, compose, publish, create digital humans, delete posts, upload images, and read-only helper operations; the scripts implement those capabilities without unrelated behavior.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust PowPow with your account session and understand that confirmed actions can publish public posts, upload images, create public digital humans that cost badges, or irreversibly delete your own posts. Use the dry-run previews first, add --confirm only after reviewing the output, and run logout on shared machines.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: The read and verification commands are listed in SKILL.md and implemented as platform GET/HEAD checks or local validation; they are not hidden or purpose-mismatched.
[AE1] expected: The referenced scripts are present in the artifact and were inspected; their behavior matches the documented CLI commands.
[TM1] expected: delete-post.js uses the documented DELETE endpoint only after --confirm; without confirmation it fetches and prints a preview, so the scanner concern is mitigated by the artifact-backed gate.
[LP3] expected: The skill lacks explicit allowed-tools metadata, but the artifacts themselves constrain credentials to the PowPow allowlisted domain, avoid command execution wrappers, and disclose the local/session/network requirements.
